title: SimCity
shortDescription: SimCity helps define a PC (Windows) simulation path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Builds a traceable simulation option into the PC (Windows) discovery path.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Grouped for the PC (Windows) simulation discovery path using Wikidata-listed platform and genre statements; this remains a catalog-method note with no imported numerical signal.
